newsitem.title: UK: Unionamerica merges to strengthen shares -chairman.
newsitem.headline: Unionamerica merges to strengthen shares -chairman.

text.p: Unionamerica Holdings Plc chairman Philip Marcell said the need to strengthen share price and carve out a position for the future were the main reasons for Wednesday's acquisition by MMI Cos Inc.

"As a company of our size quoted on the New York Stock Exchange we found it difficult to have sufficient liquidity in shares to achieve a satisfactory share price, trading off a low potential earnings ratio as we were," Marcell told Reuters.
"We also need to be bigger. Insurance entities are getting bigger and even with a speciality company like us it pays to position yourself for where you want to be tomorrow," he said.

Marcell said there was a great deal of synergy with MMI, whose healthcare policies Unionamerica has reinsured for many years. He said Unionamerica will trade forward under its own name operating within the MMI structure.
